753:t_190:4.en:
$$アル$$
「Let me also point out that the Sergeant wishes to reunite with many friends and comrades, not only Miss $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

753:t_190:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Affirmative, partner. But I doubt that dictator playing God can do anything like that.」

753:t_190:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your concern is unnecessary. As an all-knowing and all-powerful being, I...」

753:t_190:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「You never stop spouting bullshit! You're persistent, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_190:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「But rest assured. I'll spare you the trouble of all that talk about a new world! I'll defeat you and stop the universe's collapse!」

753:t_190:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「Brace yourself, dictator of the universe! However lofty you act, I'll drag you onto my turf and settle this!」

753:t_190:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll make your defeat by a mere soldier... a single human being, the greatest, most unprecedented humiliation in all history!!」

753:t_191:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you want to start your life over too, $$宗介$$?」

753:t_191:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There is nothing to worry about. In the new world I guide, you and $$かなめ$$ will receive new lives. I shall reunite you.」

753:t_191:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of asking a man like you to play Cupid!」

753:t_191:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There is no need to hold back. As an all-knowing and all-powerful being, I...」

753:t_191:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「You never stop spouting bullshit! You're persistent, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_191:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「But rest assured. I'll spare you the trouble of all that talk about a new world! I'll defeat you and stop the universe's collapse!」

753:t_191:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「Brace yourself, dictator of the universe! However lofty you act, I'll drag you onto my turf and settle this!」

753:t_191:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll make your defeat by a mere soldier... a single human being, the greatest, most unprecedented humiliation in all history!!」

753:t_192:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes, $$ボン太くん#pilot$$. I am God.」

753:t_192:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even I cannot permit that.」

753:t_192:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Very well, $$ボン太くん#pilot$$. I shall fight you with the universe's fate at stake!」

753:t_193:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$メリッサ$$... I commend your courage.」

753:t_193:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「Your smile is sickeningly bright...! Now that I think about it, you were suspicious from the start!」

753:t_193:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But you cannot refuse me. Isn't that right, $$メリッサ$$?」

753:t_193:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Don't use my name so familiarly! I don't care how confident you are. $$クルツ$$ is many times the man you are!」

753:t_193:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Get out of my way, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You're nothing but an obstacle in my life!!」

753:t_194:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Lower your gun, $$クルツ$$. Instead of wasting time on futile resistance, spend your final moments with the one you love.」

753:t_194:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Mind your own business, you Peeping Tom of a god! Stop grinning like an idiot while the universe collapses!」

753:t_194:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「As God, my mission is to see the universe through its collapse.」

753:t_194:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't make me laugh! You're just a loser who waved a white flag at the universe!」

753:t_194:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Get out of the way, you fraud! I won't let a phony smooth bastard like you ruin my future with $$メリッサ$$!!」

753:t_195:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I never expected we'd have to save the entire universe as well as the world...! Even I didn't anticipate that!」

753:t_195:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But $$ベン$$... You have regrets.」

753:t_195:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You wish you had quit $$ミスリル$$ and moved to $$アキハバラ$$ sooner, if the universe was going to perish anyway.」

753:t_195:3.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Don't use my dreams to try to unsettle me!」

753:t_195:4.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I'll make that dream come true after I overcome you! I absolutely refuse to let the universe perish before that series airs its finale!!」

753:t_196:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ゼロ$$... No, $$ルルーシュ$$. Your regret-filled days of fighting end here.」

753:t_196:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I don't mind my own end. But I cannot stand by while someone's selfishness steals the lives of people seeking a future!」

753:t_196:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This is the universe's will. I accepted it, and was given the role of carrying this world's memories to the new world.」

753:t_196:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's self-serving logic! Know that your surrender accelerated the force that seeks to vanish!」

753:t_196:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Time is running out. I will indulge your irresponsible accusations no further.」

753:t_196:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Very well, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. But I intend to take responsibility for what I said.」

753:t_196:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even if my life ends here, I'll open the way ahead... the way to the future!」

753:t_196:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll do that by defeating you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, the one falsely claiming to be God!」

753:t_196:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you still not understand it is futile, $$ルルーシュ$$!?」

753:t_196:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Silence, you who obstruct the future! My name is $$ゼロ$$...!」

753:t_196:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I am the one who brings about the miracle of victory!!」

753:t_197:0.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「How does it feel, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$? How does it feel to lose the eternity you all depended on?」

753:t_197:2.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're boring creatures, treasuring something like eternity.」

753:t_197:3.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You don't understand life's meaning or value. That's why you could smile as you watched everything perish.」

753:t_197:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But with this $$至高神Ｚ$$, I can survive the universe's collapse! If I obtain the $$スフィア$$s again afterward...!」

753:t_197:5.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's enough, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. You're already finished.」

753:t_197:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「From here on, humans... those who know life's meaning will create the future!」

753:t_198:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's over, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll pay you back for everything right here!」

753:t_198:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You fight to avenge your grudges, $$カレン$$... If you fight for something so petty, you should perish here with the old world after all.」

753:t_198:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「Like hell I will! I want what lies beyond... I want a future!」

753:t_198:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'm different from someone like you, who just smiles and watches people die to protect his own pride!!」

753:t_198:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You too think so little of my resolve as God?」

753:t_198:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「What do you mean, resolve!? Don't dress up giving up with pretty words!」

753:t_198:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll fight you and the universe's will with everything I have!」

753:t_198:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「And I'll win, no matter what! I want a future, and so does everyone else!!」

753:t_199:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「Now is the time to risk this life...!」

753:t_199:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$スザク$$... If you seek punishment to atone for your sins, I shall give it to you.」

753:t_199:2.en:
$$スザク$$
「That won't do! My mission is to throw away everything and defeat you!!」

753:t_199:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you presume to surpass me, not knowing your place?」

753:t_199:4.en:
$$スザク$$
「You've sunk into eternity and forgotten life's meaning! I'll teach you the power of humans who risk their lives!」

753:t_199:5.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$ユフィ$$, Dad...! I'll fight alongside $$ルルーシュ$$ to protect the future!」

753:t_199:6.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll stake everything I have on defeating you!!」

753:t_200:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$キリコ$$... As an $$異能生存体$$, you are a miracle born of the universe's whim.」

753:t_200:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But I am a being who has surpassed even that. Thus, I can end your days of fighting.」

753:t_200:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'm an $$異能生存体$$... That power plunged me into the flames of battle.」

753:t_200:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「But there, I... gained something irreplaceable.」

753:t_200:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Don't put on a brave front, $$キリコ$$. I am the one who will save you.」
